title: NNDC wallet cards 2023: 233U half-life 1.5919 × 10^5 y
summary: The October 2023 wallet-card row for 233U prints half-life 1.5919 × 10^5 y (year), uncertainty 12.
body: The October 2023 Nuclear Wallet Cards row for 233U prints half-life 1.5919 × 10^5 y (year). The uncertainty integer after the unit is 12. The decay-mode text before the gamma-ray energies is: α. The booklet's half-life note says the value is followed by the unit (s: second, m: minute, h: hour, d: day, y: year) and that the uncertainty follows the unit and is given in italics. Superscripts in powers of ten were read from the smaller glyphs in the PDF. Italics were not a separate character. The uncertainty is the integer in that position. The booklet says all nuclides with T1/2 longer than 1 hour are included. This is an evaluated half-life from that compilation, not a new counting experiment.

sources.title: Nuclear Wallet Cards for Radioactive Nuclides, October 2023
